title: Gambling Harm Open Data
description: Five machine-readable datasets on gambling harm and gambling recovery in the United States, published together and refreshed on a stated clock (new edition on the 15th of each month). gambling-harm-index.csv: what each of the 50 states and DC publishes about gambling harm (helpline contacts from NCPG Appendix A; state-published self-exclusion, treatment and helpline series with a source URL per row and a publication tier; 'not published' recorded as a finding). sportsbook-rg-tools.csv: the responsible-gambling tools published by US sportsbook and daily-fantasy operators. recovery-glossary.csv: a sourced glossary of gambling-recovery and gambling-industry terminology with stigma-preferred phrasing. quit-gambling-apps.csv: a panel of quit-gambling apps on the US iOS App Store. self-exclusion-programs.csv: a directory of verified state and multi-state self-exclusion programs that classifies every state: 37 statewide programs (36 states and DC) plus NVSEP; the 14 states with no statewide program are listed in the schema. Every value carries the source it came from or an explicit marker saying why it does not. Corrections are appended in new releases with dated notes and credit; prior releases stay live at their version DOI. Produced by Betttr LLC, maker of a gambling-recovery app; no operator or affiliate funding.
notes: Resource type was recorded as Software on the 2026.9.0 and 2026.9.1 Zenodo versions because the GitHub integration defaulted it; this file sets it to Dataset from the next release. Cite the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22857767 for the newest edition.
